κόθορνος, ὁ,
buskin, high boot, , , , , etc.; worn by tragic actors in heroic characters: hence,
emblem of Tragedy in the person of Dionysus, ,.
since the buskins might be worn on either foot, ὁ Κόθορνος, nickname for a trimmer or timeserver, such as Theramenes, : prov., εὐμεταβολώτερος κοθόρνου, etc.
